title: Evidence note frontmatter (users/<slug>/notes/<name>.md)
description: Output of stage 03_extract: the facts one document supports, each with the verbatim passage it rests on. Proposed facts are not in the profile yet; they enter it as draft with this note as evidence, and the user verifies them. The body of the note holds the quotes under headings that the facts' anchors point at.

source.description: The document's path relative to the user's directory (interviews/…, sources/…, inbox/…), or a description when it is not a file

status.description: applied once the facts have been added to the profile as draft

parent.description: An experience or project id in the profile, or one of new_parents

claim.description: One fact-sized sentence in the user's pivot language

metrics.description: Real numbers the document gives, nothing rounded or inferred

quote.description: The passage of the document the fact rests on, verbatim

anchor.description: Heading anchor in the note body where the quote is repeated
